_readme: One entry per ESPN team id. `nick` is what shows under the team name (from Tony's old rankings). `notes` is free text for inside jokes / context per edition.

1.notes: Runs the rankings. Most waiver moves in the league two years running (37 in 2024, 29 in 2025). 9-5 last year, 3 seed, flamed out to 6th.

2.notes: REIGNING CHAMP (2025). Most points in the league in 2025 (2035.9), 9-5, 2 seed, 31 waiver moves. Renamed TD Twisters -> Soppin Wet.

3.notes: 10-4 two years in a row, 3rd then 2nd. Never won it. Made 7 waiver moves all of 2025. Logo is a SpongeBob stink gif.

4.notes: 7-7 in 2025, 5 seed, made the playoffs with FIVE waiver moves all year. Was 'Beginner's Luck' in 2024 (9th). Drafted two kickers in 2026.

5.notes: 2024 champ. 2025: 6-8, 8th, made THREE waiver moves all season. Only guy who trades (4 in 2024).

6.notes: Mr. Middle: 7th then 5th. Team name 'Your meat too much', abbrev WWJD. Logo is a personal photo hosted on postimg.

7.notes: 5-9 both years (8th, 9th). Logo is a Magic 8-Ball. Drafted the Jaylen Waddle that Ryan's team is named after.

8.notes: 4-10 last year with the fewest points in the league (1456). Username ravens69420. Took Josh Allen at 1.04.

10.notes: 3-11 dead last in 2024 as 'Dont truzz u', rebounded to 7-7 / 4th in 2025. Team abbrev RBK.

11.notes: 1 seed in 2024 (lost final) then dead last in 2025 as 'Colorado Kool-aid'. Team is 'She's Jay-len on my Waddle', named after Jaylen Waddle only, who he did NOT draft (J Will has him). Nobody knows why Jay-len has a hyphen.
